findings.text: the after_suite record names revision 4fba21b2a while the reviewed head is 970126656 (reviewed_head_sha), so the stored after-arm ties the 147-passed gate to a commit two docs/evidence commits behind the head a reader selects the record by; I re-ran the four-file gate at 970126656 myself and reproduced 147 passed/2 skipped, so the code verdict holds, but from the record alone the after-arm's revision is not the reviewed head.

the wider crew-dispatch regression set (tests/test_crew.py, test_crew_dryrun.py, test_crew_mounted_paths.py, test_crew_dispatch_guard.py, test_dry_run_reaches_admission.py, test_plan_review_gate.py, test_brief_plan_exclusivity.py) is unmeasured at the head — its single run was invalidated when its basetemp was deleted mid-run, and every failure and error in that log names the deleted path — so the blast radius of a change to the production dispatch path is covered here only by the four-file focused gate; the reviewed node records this as a follow-on rather than claiming it. Outside this node's scope, reported under follow_ons.

the live host flight.yaml (~/.config/reckon/flight.yaml) declares no by_capability_class overlay (confirmed by reading the file), so the raised-lane resolution this record demonstrates in the test flight config steers no lane on this workstation until a host layer declares one; this is a config decision the reviewed node records, not a code defect, but a reader should not take the review as evidence that live dispatches are being raised.

the id-set in _plan_section_text (and _contains_plan_section) now resolves §5.1 to the hyphenated id s5-1 instead of the dotted s5.1, so a plan that authored a literal dotted anchor (docs/plans/crew-effort-routing.html id="s5.1", self-hosted-worker-backends.html id="s1.1") is no longer found by the direct id match; I verified no live failure results, because every such heading also prints the §X.Y text and the heading-text fallback still resolves them (_plan_section_text('§5.1') returns the section), but the direct-id path is narrower than the base's matching on a spelling a plan may still author.

justifications.durability: The guarded thing is made to happen and the refusal is shown: with the _dispatch_section_routing call at the dispatch site replaced by None the raise case reddens on 'assert section-lane == raised-lane' (the string the reviewed manifest declares), 3 failed/1 passed, EXIT=1 — I applied that mutation myself and reproduced it; the new file also fails at base with 4 failures, not a collection error; and the assertions compare against literals and config-independent expectations rather than a value the test handed the code. Docked one because the wider dispatch-path surface the wiring touches is left unmeasured at the head.
justifications.evidence: Both suite objects carry revision, command, exit_status, completed, failure_count and failure_ids, and the added-failure derivation falls out clean: base (33c5e761d) 4 failed/143 passed/2 skipped, head 147 passed/2 skipped, so added_failure_count 0 with no ids; I re-ran the four-file gate at the reviewed head 970126656 and reproduced 147 passed/2 skipped EXIT=0, and reproduced the base arm's four new-test failures. Docked two: the after_suite revision is 4fba21b2a, not the reviewed head 970126656 (the two intervening commits are docs/evidence only, and my head re-run closes the gap empirically, but the stored after-arm ties to a revision that is not the reviewed head); and the wider crew-dispatch regression set is unmeasured at the head, its one run invalidated by a mid-run basetemp deletion (recorded honestly in follow_ons).
justifications.fit: The change follows the repository's own idioms: the tests synthesise a temporary repository and point RECKON_HOME at a temp config home rather than reading or writing the real one; the four duplicate record-identity derivations collapse onto routing.section_record_id/section_anchor and promotion.py drops its local copy; no plan label, version or ticket reference appears in any staged path, symbol or comment; ruff adds no finding over the base and removes 107 (UP045 zeroed by the regeneration). Docked one for the id-lookup narrowing noted below.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Plan section 5's done-when is met on the production dispatch path, not merely a routing helper: plan_dispatch (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3604) now resolves section_routing from the node's plan section record before role routing and takes the backend it returns, so a dispatch on a section at attempts 3 resolves to raised-lane with the summary naming 'attempt 3' and the raise, and a section at attempts 2 resolves to section-lane, identical to resolve_role(config, role, spec_level); I reproduced all four new cases green at 970126656 (147 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=0) and confirmed the attempts-3/attempts-2 split directly (tests/test_section_routing_reaches_dispatch.py:189,214).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 33c5e761d 970126656 lists seven changed files, every one inside the manifest's nine declared write paths (docs/_shared/flight.schema.json and the declared docs/figures path are correctly untouched — the former regenerated byte-identical); the worker committed locally and did not mutate the plan, index or sprint state (the landing is the coordinator's to record); the heavy gate ran under the pinned interpreter with a /tmp basetemp.
